work_item: Acquire or identify complete native actual years
acceptance_rule: At least 3 distinct actual local-civil years; each selected nonleap year has 35,040 raw 15-min points and each leap year has 35,136
current_evidence: 34 dynamic-admission source has no complete actual year
required_input_or_decision: additional raw Trade Street Total/PV/BESS data or an explicitly approved separate reconstruction source
prohibited_shortcut: Do not concatenate partial calendar years, repeat 35-day data, or silently fill gaps and label result actual year

work_item: Reapply audit and admission pipeline to each candidate year
acceptance_rule: Raw audit, PV semantic correction, BESS boundary screen and building-load closure are complete; provenance and exclusions retained
current_evidence: Existing pipeline supports this but source years are incomplete
prohibited_shortcut: Do not use paper-QC imputed layer for formal degradation/economic chronology

work_item: Handle DST on each native year
acceptance_rule: Spring nonexistent local labels and fall ambiguous labels follow explicit audited rule; source point count remains native-calendar consistent

acceptance_rule: Every parameter has a single traceable manufacturer or cited literature source, unit, applicability range and version date
